instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an indoor motion capture studio. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on her left leg, extending her right leg in a high side kick towards the right. On the right, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands still, facing her. The scene is brightly lit under overhead lights on a red carpeted floor.
